acceptance_criteria.description: Recognized timeout and permission failures emit useful fixed category/messages; opaque failure no longer incorrectly blames config.
Untrusted stderr, secret markers and paths are never surfaced; unknown/ambiguous output conservative; scanner enforcement/degraded state unchanged.
Add focused regressions, attempt exact verification, preserve truthful numeric exits and baseline gaps.
